notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
Update 1.1.0
2/25/2024
added new pirate themed dialog options and ending
addded 7 new songs placed at various points in the story
added new display for the name of the endings you achieved and the total count at the end of game screen
added new checklist for all endings achieved on the end of game screen
added a prompt that appears and mentions when there is a hidden input key for special dialog options, after finishing the story once
added a new achievement: Black Flag
fixed a bug that played two different Fiora endings instead of only one after certain events

notes.title: Update Notes for 1.0.4
notes.content:
Patch 1.0.4
7/11/2022
added in an option in the menu to display your current gold carried
added in two new backgrounds for existing parts in the story (cave with blurry note and plains ruins)
fixed some script issues in one of the triggered conversations with Myshum
fixed some other small script and character placement issues

notes.title: Update Notes for 1.0.3
notes.content:
Patch 1.0.3 
7/3/2022
fixed some bugs related to acquiring 4 achievements
fixed some script errors/ character placement errors
changed raining flowers to reduce the lag it could cause
changed the castle exterior background to fit the art style better
